# Project context
- Project: business website for Radoslav Aerial Videography — aerial drone videography and photography services (EU A1/A3 certified pilot) in Krumovgrad, Bulgaria, for local businesses, hotels, events and real estate.
- Content language: English.
- Tech: plain HTML5 + one shared CSS file (styles.css). Vanilla JS only if needed. No frameworks, no build tools, no CDNs except Google Fonts.
- Design: light color theme, clean modern look, mobile-first responsive layout, accessible (semantic tags, alt text, sufficient contrast).
- Every page shares the same header (logo + navigation) and footer (copyright + links).

# Repository layout
- Each exercise has its own folder. The company website (exercises 1 and 2) is in `company-website/`; the unit converter (exercise 3) is in `unit-converter/`.
- Create and edit website files only inside `company-website/`.

# Unit converter (exercise 3)
- Project: Unit Converter web app in `unit-converter/`.
- Files: unit-converter.html, unit-converter.css, unit-converter.js. Plain HTML, one CSS file, vanilla JS.
- Each converter category is an entry in the `converters` object in unit-converter.js plus one tab button in the HTML.

# Working rules
- Do ONLY the step I ask for. Do not build future pages or features in advance.
- Never run git commands (commit, push, branch, merge). I do version control manually.
- Keep file names lowercase: index.html, services.html, about.html, contacts.html, news.html, styles.css.
- After each change, list the files you created/modified and tell me how to verify the result in the browser.
